stories.title: Ken Skates calls for devolution talks to continue after Prime Minister says no to new powers for Wales
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has called on the Welsh and UK governments to keep talking about handing more powers to Wales, after the Prime Minister turned down calls to devolve policing, justice, rail infrastructure and The Crown Estate. stories.title: Flintshire residents asked how much more they’d pay for policing on their council tax bill
stories.summary: The survey offers four options for an average Band D home, from £17.50 to £23.50 a year, and closes on 21 December.

stories.title: £100 energy payment will last less than two weeks, Citizens Advice warns
stories.summary: The charity says more than half a million prepayment households could run out of credit by mid-February as bills are forecast to rise 26% in January.

stories.title: Clwyd Pension Fund advised to reword its Israeli settlements and fossil fuel exclusions as preferences
stories.summary: Officers want councillors to reword the Clwyd Pension Fund's Israeli settlements and fossil fuel exclusions as preferences, after new statutory guidance.

stories.title: FIFA confirms UK as 2035 Women’s World Cup host, with Wrexham and Cardiff in the Welsh bid
stories.summary: Wrexham’s Racecourse is one of three Welsh stadiums in line to host matches at the 2035 FIFA Women’s World Cup, after the UK was confirmed as host of the tournament today.
